---
title: "Community - Characters"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| warning: false

library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)

# Connect to database
con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../../asset/demonax-test.sqlite")

# Read tables
players <- dbReadTable(con, "players")
daily_snapshots <- dbReadTable(con, "daily_snapshots")
daily_bestiary <- dbReadTable(con, "daily_bestiary")

DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

# Get latest snapshot for each player
latest_snapshots <- daily_snapshots |>
  group_by(player_id) |>
  filter(snapshot_date == max(snapshot_date)) |>
  ungroup()

# Calculate bestiary statistics
bestiary_stats <- daily_bestiary |>
  inner_join(latest_snapshots, by = c("snapshot_id" = "id")) |>
  group_by(player_id) |>
  summarize(
    unique_creatures = n_distinct(monster_id),
    total_kills = sum(kill_count),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Join player data with latest snapshots and bestiary stats
people_data <- players |>
  filter(!id %in% c(100001, 100004)) |>
  left_join(latest_snapshots, by = c("id" = "player_id")) |>
  left_join(bestiary_stats, by = c("id" = "player_id")) |>
  select(id, name, level, experience, magic_level, last_seen, unique_creatures, total_kills) |>
  arrange(desc(level), desc(experience))

# Create clickable name links pointing to player profiles
people_data <- people_data |>
  mutate(
    Name = paste0(
      '<a href="/qmd/characters/',
      id,
      '.html" style="color: #004294; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500;">',
      name,
      '</a>'
    ),
    Level = level,
    Experience = format(experience, big.mark = ","),
    `Last Seen` = last_seen
  ) |>
  select(Name, `Last Seen`, Level, Experience)

# Create interactive table
DT::datatable(people_data,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 25,
            searching = TRUE,
            ordering = TRUE
          ),
          rownames = FALSE,
          escape = FALSE, 
          caption = "Characters")
```
